## C1 — Aster import specification

Date: 2022-04-04. Storage owner: Robin Vale. Named document author: Leah Noor.
Body sections and two comments were exported; revision history unavailable.

Body: Leah Noor authored the import flow specification. Sam Rook owns the parser.
Robin Vale built the keyboard-navigation prototype used in the April study.

Comment by Robin, 2022-04-06: The error list needs focus management after retry;
otherwise keyboard users must traverse the entire list again. The prototype now
returns focus to the first remaining error.

Reply by Leah, 2022-04-07: Incorporated that focus rule into the specification.

## C2 — April import usability study

Date: 2022-04-18. Author: Taylor West. Complete findings excerpt below.

Six participants used Robin's prototype; five completed the retry task without
moderator assistance. There was no comparison condition. Leah prepared the task
flow and Taylor ran the sessions. The study did not measure shipped behavior or
production impact. Launch timing is not recorded here.
